##### Project general facts

Peace Homes Development presents a contemporary residential project Peace Lagoons 2, designed to bring together comfort, functionality, and a sense of private luxury. The development offers a thoughtfully curated selection of studios, one-bedroom residences with a study, and two-bedroom homes with a study, all created for modern lifestyles that value both practicality and elegance. What makes the project especially distinctive is the inclusion of a private pool with every residence, transforming each home into a personal retreat defined by privacy and relaxation.

The interiors are designed to offer a seamless move-in experience while leaving space for individuality and personal style. Each home is semi-furnished and features modern high-quality finishes, an equipped kitchen with essential appliances, a washing machine, and built-in wardrobes. This balance of convenience and understated sophistication creates a living environment that feels polished, welcoming, and easy to adapt to everyday life.

At the heart of the project is the idea of elevated everyday living, where comfort is enhanced by thoughtful details and private amenities. The presence of a private pool in every unit adds a resort-like quality to the residential experience, offering residents an exclusive space to unwind at any moment. Combined with the project’s practical layouts and carefully considered interiors, it creates a lifestyle that feels both contemporary and indulgent.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) is a sprawling and diverse community located in Dubai, offering a multitude of entertainment, leisure, and residential opportunities. This vibrant community is renowned for its wide range of attractions and experiences, making it a unique destination that caters to residents and visitors of all ages.

At the heart of Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) is its extensive array of world-class entertainment and leisure destinations. The community is home to numerous theme parks, including Dubai Parks and Resorts, which features Legoland, Motiongate, Bollywood Parks, and the immersive waterpark experience of Legoland Water Park. These attractions provide endless fun and entertainment for families, creating memorable experiences for both children and adults alike.

Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) also boasts a variety of sporting facilities and outdoor spaces, catering to the needs of sports enthusiasts and those seeking an active lifestyle. The community is home to renowned golf courses, tennis courts, cycling tracks, and expansive parks, providing opportunities for outdoor activities and leisurely pursuits.
